companyDescription: Gene therapy · Modifier gene therapy platform (OCU400/OCU410/OCU410ST) targeting retinitis pigmentosa, geographic atrophy, and Stargardt disease — deeply discounted small-cap with three converging Q3 2026 catalysts
priceNote: Trading mid-range of its 52-week band ($0.93-$2.73), below its 200-day average, ahead of a Q3 2026 catalyst cluster
summary: Ocugen has three catalysts converging in Q3 2026: the rolling BLA filing start for OCU400 (retinitis pigmentosa, Phase 3 enrollment complete), interim OCU410ST data in Stargardt disease, and continued OCU410 geographic-atrophy readouts. At a $427M market cap and $1.23 share price against a Street average target of $11.43 (high $22, post a July 2026 hike from Lucid Capital), the market is pricing in very little of the platform's stated potential. Cash runway extends to 2028 after a May 2026 convertible note raise, removing near-term survival risk, but real dilution overhang remains from that note and outstanding warrants. This name has already re-rated hard on incremental good news before (+75% in 2025, +148% over the trailing year on a run of positive preliminary readouts) — the Q3 2026 cluster is the next test of that pattern, with the real pivotal OCU400 Phase 3 data not landing until Q4 2026/Q1 2027.
